name: Monobot.AI
tagline: Voice and chat AI agents for customer support and appointment booking
description:
Monobot.AI is a platform for building voice and chat AI agents for business customer conversations. Teams can use it to handle routine support questions, product consultations, scheduling, reservations and appointment booking. Agents can draw on a business knowledge base, connect with CRM and helpdesk tools, and hand conversations over to human staff when needed. The platform includes a workspace for managing agents and conversations, automation flows and interaction analytics. It is intended for businesses and contact centers that want to automate repetitive conversations while keeping people available for complex requests.

The founders are Arkady Erlikhman, Founder & CEO, whose background includes more than 20 years running software organizations and expertise in contact-center software and outsourcing, and Alexey Shulyak, Founder & CTO, a long-time technical leader. Product and team information is available at https://monobot.ai/ and https://monobot.ai/company/about-us/.
